title: EconomicAuthoritySessionRecovery
description: POST /sessions/recover request and 200 response. Unpaid, outside the x402 pipeline -- recovering access to a session already paid for costs nothing further. See hosted/a2a_economic_authority/sessions.py::handle_session_recovery_request and capabilities.py::get_session_purchase_for_recovery/rotate_session_credential.

payment_nonce.description: The EIP-3009 authorization nonce from the ORIGINAL payment -- generated by the buyer's own x402 client (x402.mechanisms.evm.utils.create_nonce) before that payment was ever signed or sent, so the buyer already holds it independent of any response from this service. NEVER the server-generated session_id -- see the capability doc's Recovery section for exactly why.

recovery_secret.description: The plaintext secret whose SHA-256 hash was sent as recovery_secret_hash on the original POST /sessions request. Proof of knowledge of this secret is the entire authorization for this route -- payment_nonce alone is never sufficient, since it is not secret.

session_id.description: Resolved and returned here because the buyer may not have learned it any other way (the scenario recovery exists for).

token.description: A FRESH root capability token. Supersedes and revokes any previously issued root credential for this session -- at most one is ever live.
